retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: per platform and command, 21 accepted TIMING job records (runs-on, P, D0, I0, cold and warm latencies, preflight fields) plus the five operative rank values under D-102 (p50=11, p95=20, p99=21). The no-load observation launch is not one of the 21 timing samples. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: For each D-102 class label and each of --help and --version: N=21 accepted jobs; cold p50/p95/p99 and warm p95/p99 meet D-006 bounds already in ms; thin-only preflight passed; never Rosetta. Warm p50 is telemetry and must not fail qualification.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: D-102 fleet-class timing corpus. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: digest-pinned cold versus warm cache-state distinction for each accepted TIMING job, under D-102 thin-only projection. Fixtures are unauthored.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Every accepted job used the D-102 class label and the cold/warm distinction required by D-006 clause 3. A fat/universal image as the measurement projection fails. This occupancy does not amend D-102 preflight.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: D-102 fleet-class timing corpus. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: one dedicated no-load observation record per command carrying the two hostile-fixture digests and the retained event stream. Linux observation child may use strace -f -e trace=file,process because that child is not a timing sample. macOS observation child uses fs_usage -w scoped to that child, or a sandbox profile that DENIES open/read/exec/mmap of the two fixture trees. The timed G03 child is never ptraced or suspended. Fixtures FC-G03-COMPONENT-PRESENT and FC-G03-PROJECT-PRESENT remain unauthored; this occupancy does not invent those bytes.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: Zero load events against either fixture tree. Missing observation is a fail, not a pass. The no-load observation is not taken on a timing sample. This occupancy does not invent a machine identifier outside D-102.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: D-102 no-load observation corpus. Not authored.
